name: House Red Wine
description:
A rough red table wine with a little tannin and plenty of fruit. It is served from the house jug and makes no claim to a famous vineyard.

One purchase supplies one quarter-pint of wine. The inn retains its serving vessel; takeaway requires your own suitable container. Alcohol effects are left to the GM.

weight.notes: Contents-only weight of one quarter-pint of wine, using the project liquid allowance of 1 lb per pint (small spirit measures rounded to 0.06 lb). The inn retains its vessel; carried containers weigh separately.
